options.accounting: coinbase or consensus reward outputs receive subsidy + all verified fees
options.supply_effect: fees redistributed; net UTXO supply change equals subsidy
options.miner_security_budget: maximal direct miner revenue for a given realized fee total
options.long_run: can transmit realized fee demand into miner revenue after subsidy decline
options.incentive_boundary: Concentrated fees can increase fee-sniping/undercutting incentives; requires adversarial/reorg stress review.

options.accounting: verified fee amount is removed from spendable supply
options.supply_effect: net UTXO supply change equals subsidy - fees
options.miner_security_budget: fees provide zero direct miner security budget
options.long_run: cannot provide a fee-funded PoW budget as subsidy tends to zero
options.incentive_boundary: reduces direct miner jackpot from historical fees but makes circulating supply depend on transaction fee volume

options.accounting: alpha*fees credited to miner; remainder explicitly burned
options.supply_effect: net UTXO supply change equals subsidy - (1-alpha)*fees
options.long_run: fee-funded budget floor is alpha times realized fee flow

options.accounting: some verified fee share is routed to a non-miner recipient
options.supply_effect: if recipient is spendable, fees are redistributed rather than burned
options.fair_launch_boundary: Any privileged treasury/admin/community recipient is a new allocation/governance policy and requires explicit Waterfound authority; it cannot be inferred from current fair-launch constraints.

robust_independent_conclusions: Fee conservation/accounting can be frozen independently of block-time selection.
The chosen fee destination can be represented by explicit alpha and destination semantics without changing the subsidy cap arithmetic.
At F=0, all policies collapse to subsidy-only miner revenue.
At F>0, miner-paid share increases miner protocol revenue exactly by alpha*F; this is accounting, not a proof of attack-cost adequacy.
If the intended long-run PoW model relies on transaction fees after subsidy decay, alpha=0 cannot satisfy that objective by construction.
A fee-paid coinbase should have one explicit maturity/origin rule; whether fee-derived coinbase value shares subsidy maturity is deferred to B6 rather than silently assumed.
explicit_Waterfound_policy_choices_requi: fee destination: miner / burn / split / separately justified non-miner recipient
whether long-run PoW security is explicitly intended to rely on fees as subsidy decays
whether fee-derived coinbase value shares the same maturity as subsidy-derived coinbase value
not_yet_selectable_from_current_evidence: numeric safe subsidy or halving schedule

external_research_directional_only.use: Supports treating fee sniping/undercutting and fee-based miner incentives as adversarial design variables; not FAE evidence.
